payload.title: File:Herugavialis cairensis (holotype, SMNS 10575 - lateral).png
payload.artist_html: P. M. J. Burke, S. N. F. Spiekman, B. S. Salem, S. Saber, H. M. Sallam & P. D. Mannion
payload.credit_html: "Cranial anatomy of the Middle Eocene Egyptian crocodylian Herugavialis cairensis provides new insights into gavialoid diversity in the Mediterranean region"
payload.description_html: The holotype skull (SMNS 10575) of Herugavialis cairensis (a) Photograph of SMNS 10575 in right lateral view, (b) interpretative drawing of SMNS 10575 in right lateral view, (c) photograph of SMNS 10575 in left lateral view and (d) interpretative drawing of SMNS 10575 in left lateral view. Abbreviations: itf, intertemporal fenestra; j, jugal; l, lacrimal; m, maxilla; mt, maxillary tooth; o, orbit; pf, prefrontal; pfp, prefrontal pillar; po, postorbital; pob, postorbital bar; q, quadrate; sq, squamosal. Scale bar, 100 mm.
